entries.grounds: CORRECTED GROUNDS. Mutant: holder = runs[0] if runs else {'unread': []} (drops 'unaccounted'). holder['unaccounted'] is read only inside unknown() (L720-722) via the final siblings loop L770-774 (listed/sibling_of errors on the fallback holder). The else-dict is used ONLY when `runs` is empty. The author's condition is INCOMPLETE: `runs` is empty iff (a) predecessor is None [then at=None, the L756 while is skipped], OR (b) child is not None AND key(child)==key(predecessor) [then key(predecessor) is pre-seeded in `seen`]. Neither occurs at any caller: run.py:524 calls lineage_account only inside `if predecessor is not None:` (L518) and passes out (a fresh run dir, != predecessor) -> rules out BOTH (a) and (b); verify.py:86 passes pathlib.Path(c['path']) (non-None) and out (!=) -> rules out both; bundle_cli.py:947 passes run_dir (non-None) with child=None -> seen=set(), the first while iteration adds, so runs is non-empty (the author's 'child=None so never empty' is only true because run_dir is non-None). run.py:518's `if predecessor is not None` guard -- the load-bearing fact that rules out case (a) -- was not cited by the author. So the else-branch is dead for every caller; when it is never reached the mutant has no effect; if it were reached AND a final listed()/sibling_of() hit a LineageRefused/unreadable claim, unknown() would KeyError on the missing 'unaccounted' key (a real behavioural difference -> not EQUIVALENT, correctly AUDITED).
